newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, ELECT TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, ELECT TO BAT.

text.p: Pakistan won the toss and elected to bat against Bangladesh in the second match of the sixth Asia Cup tournament at Colombo's R. Premadasa stadium on Wednesday.
Bangladesh - M. Akram (captain), Aminul Islam, Athar Ali Khan, M. Habibul Bashar, Minhajul Abdin, Khaled Mashud, Saiful Islam, Naimul Rahman, Hasibul Hossain, Enamul Haq, Shaikh Salahuddin.
Pakistan - Rameej Raja, Saeed Anwar, Shahid Afridi, Amir Sohail, Salim Malik, Injman-ul-Haq, Moin Khan, Saqlain Mushtaq, Arshad Khan, Aquib Jawed, Kabir Khan.
